baseline.name: Scientometrics
baseline.scope_notes: Quantitative science-of-science research, including indicators, citation/collaboration networks, research evaluation and computational studies of scholarly records. Research articles must supply methods or insights; reviews are invited. The standard research route uses single-anonymous peer review. Current instructions require human authorship and documentation of substantive LLM use in Methods or an appropriate section; copyediting of human-written text is exempt from disclosure. This does not remove author accountability.

route.conditions: Current journal policy offers subscription publication without an APC. OA is optional and paid. Online colour is free; print colour requires a contribution and can be avoided. The inspected instructions do not explicitly exclude submission or page/overlength fees, so zero total author cost remains unverified. No required membership or affiliation was stated.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Submission and page/overlength charges are unconfirmed. Optional print colour, author services and third-party reproduction permissions can cost extra.
